rows.section: Manage recycling obligations home page for producer and CSO users
rows.english: A minimum of {{glassTarget}}% of your glass recycling obligation must be made up of glass re-melt PRNs or PERNs. This will make up a proportion of your overall glass recycling obligation. The remaining glass recycling obligation can be met by either glass re-melt, glass other or a mix of both.
